title: H2 two attachment slots per tile engine, ordered retirement and shared-L2 progress
scope: Uncommitted H2 hardware development checkpoint. H0-H8 functionality and whole-GPU qualification remain incomplete.
current_stage_ppa_policy: Synthesis only, as requested by the user. Historical routing reports apply only to their frozen emissions.

architecture.retirement: Two metadata entries per engine; in-order slot completions retain bytes, faults and ownership through result consumption.
architecture.alias_admission: Separate allocations or compatible same-plane views with disjoint tile rectangles. Caller pins VM and excludes physical aliases.
architecture.progress: Separate slot clients, byte-overlap hazards, per-engine export reservation and half of L2 store capacity retained as headroom.
architecture.cached_read_hazards: Whole-line through final upstream store response consumption; only aligned disjoint byte-mask writes bypass other writes.

emitted_configuration.scope: Bounded two-engine fixed-function renderer; compute units and the actual shared L2 are outside this synthesis top.

native_test_configuration.image_oracle: Separate ordered unbinned RenderPipeline simulation, including blend/depth/stencil and partial edge/scissor behavior. It shares arithmetic/backend RTL and verifies integration ordering rather than independently proving those arithmetic blocks.

shared_system_test_configuration.overlap: Withhold older top-row external export acknowledgements until both engine second-slot loads are accepted; then compare final image and reuse under fresh VM/backing.
shared_system_test_configuration.shader_staging: Still memory-backed; H5 on-chip payload work remains open.

coverage: Younger load/render while all older slot store acknowledgements are withheld.
Real SRAM vendor model, 8 export credits, 4x MSAA, last sample index 1023 and separate slot banks.
Native binned interleaved image on behavioral and macro SRAM.
Late older export fault attribution, cancellation during younger offered reads, safe drain and healthy reuse.
Empty tiles ahead of prefetched draws, exact per-slot byte accounting and simultaneous partial resolve.
Real shared-CU bare/Sv32 rendering and overlap, legacy shared-system profiles through 4 CUs/16 lanes/8 warps.
Disjoint masked L2 writes, reverse acknowledgements, whole-line read hazards, coherent refill, AMO and uncached local IDs.
Legacy single-slot store, persistent renderer credit windows, bin storage/replay/cache, admission and exact UNORM arithmetic.

prior_failures.problem: Four-tile shared-Sv32 run stalled behind an older export and an L2 same-line store.
prior_failures.correction: Separate slot arbitration, disjoint mask writes, mobile four-entry L2 store table and per-engine reserved export credit.

prior_failures.problem: First broad regression: 218/219 passed; macro simulation failed to compile because the vendor resource was absent.
prior_failures.correction: Link the unmodified vendor SRAM functional model through a test-only inline blackbox; production macro RTL unchanged.
